title: RDF Data Manager deployment configuration
description: config.json next to index.html. Every key is optional; the user's saved settings and URL parameters win unless locked is true.

updateUrl.description: SPARQL update endpoint; defaults to queryUrl

dataGraph.description: Named graph holding the data; empty for the default graph

shapes.description: Where the SHACL/DASH shapes come from

language.description: Preferred language tag for labels, e.g. en, nb, nn

locked.description: true hides Settings and ignores saved settings and URL parameters

languages.description: Language tags offered in Settings; the shapes' rdm:languages are added

widgets.description: Widgets to load: the bundled names map and time, or URLs of ES modules whose default export is a Widget or an array of Widgets
